snippet.title: Haunted Lands | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Haunted Lands Now: https://s.team/a/2980900

Haunted Lands is a brutal retro-inspired action platformer where you battle monstrous cultists, unearth forbidden secrets, and wield powerful artifacts in cursed crypts and forsaken tombs. Choose your hero, face relentless horrors, and survive the blood-soaked trials of the Haunted Lands.
